test_player.test_record_seen_card_does_not_overwrite_existing(player)¶

Verify earlier notes are not overwritten by later ones.

Call record_seen_card twice with the same card name. The first value should be preserved, confirming the guard condition in record_seen_card() works correctly.

Verify player is prompted when multiple cards match.

Mock input() to return ‘1’ so the test does not hang waiting for keyboard input.
